raw.query: SELECT run_id, policy, sla_metric, bound_ms, achieved_p99_ms, overage_ratio, has_raw_backing FROM v_infraction WHERE sla_metric='ttft' AND is_current=true ORDER BY run_id LIMIT 40
raw.observed: v_infraction holds only simulated TTFT p99 SLA infractions vs a 1000 ms bound (overage_ratio); no client-observed/live TTFT column and no live-vs-simulated comparison
raw.claimed: client-observed TTFT tails within 1.1–6.8% of simulated ones (single live run per policy)
raw.evidence: Designated backing v_infraction contains no live/client-observed TTFT and no live-vs-simulated delta; only simulated SLA infraction checks, so the 1.1–6.8% point difference cannot be sourced from it
raw.fix: Back the claim with v_live_anchor (live TTFT p99) joined to the matching simulated run's TTFT p99 and report the per-policy point differences; v_infraction only supports simulated SLA-infraction checks, not live-vs-simulated validation
